title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378J (Option to inter-State co-operative societies to become Producer Companies)

content.overview: Notwithstanding section 378C(1), any inter-State co-operative society with objects not confined to one State may apply to the Registrar for registration as a Producer Company. The application must be accompanied by a special resolution of not less than two-thirds of total members, a statement of directors/Chief Executive and list of members, a statement that the society is engaged in one or more objects under section 378B, and a declaration by two or more directors. On registration the words ‘Producer Company Limited’ form part of its name.
content.glance: Inter-State co-operative societies may convert to Producer Companies on a 2/3-member special resolution and the prescribed application documents.
content.study: Section 378J provides a conversion route for inter-State co-operative societies whose objects are not confined to one State. The conversion is effected by application to the Registrar supported by the documents listed in sub-section (2). Upon registration the society becomes a Producer Company and the name must include ‘Producer Company Limited’.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: An inter-State co-operative society may apply for registration as a Producer Company on a ≥2/3-member special resolution and the prescribed supporting documents; the name must then include ‘Producer Company Limited’.

provisions.title: Option to inter-State co-operative societies to become Producer Companies

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378J
examples.body: An inter-State co-operative society engaged in marketing primary produce of its members obtains a two-thirds special resolution and registers as a Producer Company under s. 378J.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378J?
hypotheticals.analysis: It opens a conversion route for inter-State co-operative societies into Producer Companies on the stated resolution and document conditions.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming any co-operative society may convert under this section.
misconceptions.correction: Only inter-State co-operative societies with objects not confined to one State may use s. 378J.

questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Confirm inter-State character and objects. II. Check resolution and documents. III. Conclude on conversion.
